verdict.rationale: Omnara is a platform for running and supervising general-purpose agents. Agents can run on a connected laptop or server, use tools and MCP servers, spawn subagents, and accept live corrections. A community user reports running Claude Code through it, which suggests it can host agents that write code. However, nothing documents an agent implementing a feature end-to-end or writing tests. Missing for 10: documented coding or feature-implementation workflow, test-writing capability, repository or code-change handling, and hands-on evidence of completed features with tests.
